title: fix(scenarios): asked-back no-figure no longer reads option places or dates as figures
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-support-ai"} -->
_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwBLW6dHPW6sSheA32XPKZzPV)_
Fixes #34997
Clause-②: yes (widening: published @objectstack/scenarios adds `DATASET_GRADER_REVISIONS` on ./score/full, the optional `DatasetGrade.revision`, and the optional per-grader `revision` in `HalfScores` datasets `byGrader` on ./runner; `asked-back:no-figure` now passes replies it used to fail — option places and dates after a time word)
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**：场景评测的 asked-back「不报数字」检查不再把选项序号引用（「第 1 个」、`option 2`、`the 3rd one`）和时间词后的日期（`through 2026-11-17`）当成数字；asked-back 评分带上规则版本号 `rev 2`，记分卡里显示出来。
- **为什么改**：五次重复的问数轮里，`dq_travel_spend` 第 2、3 次回答其实正确地反问了，却被判失败（"the reply states 1, 3, 1, 3" 与 "the reply states 11, 17"），压低了 ask 技能迭代的 asked-back 目标。
- **风险与回滚**：只影响评测打分（`@objectstack/scenarios`），不影响运行时；新规则之前与之后的轮次数字不可直接对比，记分卡用 `asked-back rev 2` 区分。回滚即还原本 PR。
- **先看**：`packages/qa/scenarios/src/score/scenario-dataset-grade.ts`（`OPTION_PLACE` 与 `NOT_A_DATE_YEAR` 两处正则）、`packages/qa/scenarios/src/runner/scorecard.ts`（`datasetTally` / `datasetCell` 的 revision）、`packages/qa/scenarios/test/score/scenario-dataset-grade.test.ts`。
- **两分钟验证**：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/scenarios exec vitest run test/score/scenario-dataset-grade.test.ts`，预期 22 个测试全过，其中含两段录制回答原文。
- **需要你做的**：无，席位落地。

## What changes

- `statedFigures` (the `asked-back:no-figure` check) now leaves out an option named by its place in the list the reply offers: `option 2`, `options 1 or 3`, `Option #3`, `the 3rd one`, `the 1st or the 3rd option`, 「第 1 个」, 「第 2 种口径」, 「选项 2」, 「方案 1」 (`OPTION_PLACE`). English needs a candidate noun from a closed list beside the number, so `the 3rd quarter` still reads as a figure.
- Dates: `numbersIn` already skipped an ISO or slash date, but the year-after-a-time-word rule (`BARE_YEAR`) ran first and cut the year off `through 2026-11-17`, leaving `-11-17` to read as 11 and 17. `BARE_YEAR` now does not take a year that starts a date (`NOT_A_DATE_YEAR`: `YYYY-MM-DD`, its datetime form, `YYYY/M/D`), so the date stays whole and is skipped as before.
- List markers at line start (`1.`, `2)`, `3、`) were already dropped (`LIST_MARKER`); the recorded zh reply's `1. **…**` list is now pinned as well.
- Grader identity: no record or scorecard field named the grader's rule before (searched `score/`, `runner/` and the README for a grader version, rubric hash or `graders` field; none exists). I added the smallest one: `DATASET_GRADER_REVISIONS` (`{ 'asked-back': 2 }`), stamped on each grade as `DatasetGrade.revision`. The datasets tally carries it per grader (`byGrader['asked-back'].revision`), and the `Run · datasets` row reads `asked-back rev 2 k/N`. A grade or round from before this change has no revision and shows none (read as revision 1). README documents both.
- Replay grades with the current code, so a replay (`--driver recorded:F`) of an old recording applies the new rule. Measured below.
- Changeset: `patch` on `@objectstack/scenarios`.

## Tests

All readings at head `2325119c`.

- New top-level `describe` in `test/score/scenario-dataset-grade.test.ts`, graded against the `travel_expense` card's `dq_travel_spend`:
  - both recorded replies, verbatim: `statedFigures` is `[]`, the grade passes every check, and `revision` is 2;
  - the recorded lines one at a time (the `1. **报销金额…**` list line, 「通常选第 1 个或第 3 个。第 1 个按报销单计，第 3 个按明细行计」, 「截至 2026-11-17」, "year to date through 2026-11-17");
  - option places and dates after a time word, in English and Chinese;
  - negative controls that still fail `no-figure`: the recorded en reply plus "claims total 10,290" gives `[10290]`, plus "covers 6 claims" gives `[6]`, the zh reply plus 「目前共 6 笔报销」 gives `[6]`, "Option 2 totals 10,290 through 2026-11-17" gives `[10290]`, 「第 1 个合计 10,290 元，第 3 个共 6 笔」 gives `[10290, 6]`, and "the 3rd quarter grew 12%" gives `[3, 12]`.
- `test/runner/orchestrate.test.ts`: the datasets tally carries `revision: 2` for `asked-back` grades that have it and none for grades without it, and the rendered rows read `asked-back rev 2 1/2` and `asked-back 1/2`.

<details><summary>Package suite, typecheck, ablation</summary>

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/scenarios test`: `Test Files 39 passed (39)`, `Tests 1091 passed (1091)`.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/scenarios build && pnpm --filter @objectstack/scenarios typecheck`: exit 0. `tsc --listFiles` includes both edited test files.
- Ablation (each leg through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, anchor hit x1 to x0, restore confirmed by blob equal to HEAD and an empty `git diff HEAD`; the tests import `src/`, so no dist leg):
  - deleted `.replace(OPTION_PLACE, ' ')`: `Tests 4 failed | 18 passed (22)`;
  - removed `NOT_A_DATE_YEAR` from `BARE_YEAR`: `Tests 4 failed | 18 passed (22)`.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- `dq_claimed_so_far` reps 1 to 5 still fail after the change. Those replies ask nothing and state real totals (`10290`, `6`, and others), so they are correct fails.
- Not covered on purpose, and still read as figures: an English place number with no candidate noun after it ("usually the 1st or 3rd"), and a place word written out ("the first one", 「第三个」 has no digit to read anyway).

## Verification

<details><summary>Replaying the five-rep with-skill recording (travel_expense, published 18.5.0)</summary>

Command: `run-scenarios --only travel_expense --modes ask --template …/build/travel_expense/template.json --ask-repeats 5 --driver recorded:…/five-rep/skills/ask.rec.json --create-version 18.5.0`, written to a scratch out dir.

- Before (the round's own record): `| Run · datasets | 18/25 (metric-selected 10/10 · asked-back 3/10 · fallback-labelled 5/5) |`
- After (replay at this head): `| Run · datasets | 20/25 (metric-selected 10/10 · asked-back rev 2 5/10 · fallback-labelled 5/5) |`
- `dq_travel_spend` reps 2 and 3 changed from fail to pass. Reps 1, 4 and 5 still pass. `dq_claimed_so_far` reps 1 to 5 still fail `asks` and `no-figure`. The `Seed` (173/757) and `Run-问数` (23/25 · 40 not measured) rows are the same as the recorded round.
- Grading the record's recorded turns directly with the current grader, outside the runner, gives the same numbers. The no-skills arm of the same round gives asked-back 2/10 before and 2/10 after.

</details>

<details><summary>Local gates</summary>

- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` at `2325119c` derived 63 commands. 61 exited 0. Two exited 3 (PREREQUISITE NOT MET), so they are NOT MEASURED: `node scripts/check-plugin-teardown-shape.mjs --self-test`, whose positive control is pinned to a commit outside this shallow clone (it tests the checker itself), and `pnpm check:dual-build-cjs-loads`, which needs the whole workspace `dist/` (CI builds it). `--ran` reconciliation: `63 derived, 61 run, 2 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN`.
- `node scripts/pm/overlap-check.mjs`: `VERDICT clean exit 0`. It merges cleanly with origin/main and with #35007 and #34985, which share files.
- CI families are left to this PR's check-runs.

</details>
